inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler: I observed one unlabeled cup in the classroom.     Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Records were evaluated for ten children enrolled and the following was determined:    The admission date is needed for one child.   School information is needed for two children enrolled.   An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: During today's inspection I observed an eighteen month old child seated in a high chair eating a snack. The safety straps were not fastened.     Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: During breakfast, the children in care were served one french toast stick with syrup and a cup of milk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Additional loose fill surfacing is needed on the outdoor play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: A maintenance/safety checklist was not completed for the month of May.    Note: During this inspection the operation completed a checklist for the month of June.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Two staff members completed online only pediatric CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play: A supply of drinking water was not available to children in care during breakfast time.     Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play (26 TAC §746.3301(f)(1))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The number/child assignment chart in the toddler classroom was reviewed and showed all children present were not included on the chart.     Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: The fastener to the middle seat on the first row of the transportation vehicle would not fasten during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Center not on probation, suspension, emergency suspension, or revocation in two years preceding or admin penalty: Transportation training provided to staff who transport children did not meet training criteria as the operation received an administrative penalty in the two years prior to othe training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center not on probation, suspension, emergency suspension, or revocation in two years preceding or admin penalty (26 TAC §746.1317(a)(6)(B))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: A caregiver responsible for a group of children ages 5-9 years old was unaware of the number of children responsible for. The caregiver stated 15, however 16 were present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A caregiver with a provisional background checks was observed in caring for a group of 8 children ages 4-7 years old. The group did not have another caregiver present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was observed with five children ages 5 months, 8 months, 10 months, 13 months, and 13 months. The specified age group is 0-11 children which allows one caregiver to supervise four children. The caregiver was over ratio by one child.     Note: An additional caregiver was added to the room during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: During this inspection the classroom sign in and out logs were reviewed. The toddler sign in and out log showed ten children signed in however nine were present.     Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Records were evaluated for ten children in care and the following was determined:      Two children needed a special needs statement.   Two children needed an emergency contact other than the parent.   One child needed a health statement signed by a physician.   One child needed an updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit in the transportation van was reviewed and the following items were needed:    -Scissors  -Thermometer  -Cotton Balls    Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: The caregiver in the Pre-K classroom was unaware of the group responsible for. The caregiver stated nine children were present, however ten were counted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: The caregiver in the Toddler classroom was unaware of the group responsible for. The caregiver stated six children were present, however seven were counted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The classroom sign in and out logs were reviewed and showed six of seven children in the Toddler class were signed in.    Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: During this inspection I observed a nineteen month old seated in a high chair. The safety straps were not in use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: The caregiver in the Toddler classroom was unaware of the group responsible for. The caregiver stated seven children were present, however eight were counted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The classroom sign in and out logs were reviewed and showed six of eight children in the Toddler class were signed in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: An eleven month old was observed laying in a crib with a pacifier attached to the shirt.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A food allergy emergency plan is needed for one child enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information obtained, the operation failed to report a child was left alone on the transportation van for approximately one hour and fifteen minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information obtained, the operation did not provide the parent with an incident report regarding a situation placing a child at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on the information obtained, it was determined the director failed to maintain supervision when a child was left in a van to the far left of the operation near a main street.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: Based on the information obtained, the vehicle used for transporting children was not equipped with a child safety alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: Based on the information obtained, a child was not signed in at the operation after being picked up from school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on the information obtained, the operation failed to ensure a child was not neglected when a child was left unsupervised on a transportation van for approximately one hour and fifteen minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children: Based on the information obtained, the center director admitted to not entering the transportation vehicle to account for all children present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children (26 TAC §746.5605(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: While inspecting the outdoor play area I observed broken fence pickets, trash/debris, and ant piles.    Note: The operation removed the trash from the outdoor play area during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The operation did not have documentation showing the fire extinguishers are checked monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher in the transportation van is in need of servicing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: A staff member counted in the child/caregiver ratio is in need of eight hours of pre-service training.     A staff member counted in the child/caregiver ratio is in need of twenty four hours of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Personnel records were evaluated for six staff members and the following was determined:    One caregiver needed documentation showing how they meet the minimum education qualifications.     One caregiver needed a notarized affidavit.     The director needed a current ID/Driver's License.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Orientation training is needed for one caregiver who has unsupervised access to a children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Documentation reviewed for four of six staff members showed the Pediatric CPR training was completed online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Records were evaluated for ten children enrolled and the following was determined:    One needed an updated immunization record.   Two needed an emergency contact.  One needed a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: During this investigation it was determined that a caregiver used prohibited punishment such as yelling at the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection was conducted on 02/05/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: One crib used for an infant in care needed a label.     Note: This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Updated feeding instructions were needed for one infant in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Six personnel records were evaluated and the following was determined:    One needed a copy of a current drivers license   One needed a notarized Licensing Affidavit   Four needed education qualifications
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Two toilets and three sinks near the after schooler's classroom needed repair.    Four sinks and one toilet near the toddler classroom needed repairs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: Four cribs needed snug fitting sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Records were evaluated for ten children enrolled and the following was determined:    Eight needed special needs statement  Three needed immunization info  Three needed a health statement  One needed an emergency contact  One needed school information
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One staff member needed Pediatric CPR/First Aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
